description: Pinned reference episode for the Smokes stock patham9 example at commit 55f1751. This is the semantic anchor for the first fail-closed end-to-end episode gate. Two runs produced byte-identical output, confirming determinism.

build_artifacts.smokes_so_note: Compiled from RUN.scm + cinterface.scm using csc -O3 -DUSE_TYPES. Located at metta-morph/extend/SMOKES.so.

environment.note: SMOKES.so cannot be copied to /usr/lib/ without root. LD_LIBRARY_PATH pointing at the metta-morph/extend directory is the no-root workaround. ctypes.CDLL('SMOKES.so') finds it through dlopen search.

reproducibility_command: export PATH=$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH && export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=$HOME/metta-morph/extend:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH && cd ~/PLN && bash build.sh && cd examples && metta Smokes.metta 2>/dev/null

boundaries.scope: Phase-0 baseline reference artifact only. This does not execute the Phase-2 episode gate, invoke the petta-memory pipeline, or authorize any promotion, write, or live integration.

open_risks: Rule/trace identity: byte-identical traces from structurally distinct rule applications would let exact-replay pass over a semantic substitution. Not caught by rerun determinism alone; needs a deliberately perturbed rule set as a post-integration boundary test.
Executable TOCTOU: SMOKES.so hash is recorded but filesystem replacement between hash and load remains possible. The Phase-2 executable-pinning machinery narrows but does not eliminate this.
LD_LIBRARY_PATH dependency: reproducibility requires the loader path to be set. A permanent fix would use an absolute path in ctypes.CDLL or rpath in the .so.
